name: Rivile GAMA
description: Connect Rivile GAMA, the Lithuanian ERP and accounting system, to Claude or ChatGPT through the Rivile API v2: clients, products, stock balances and prices, purchase and sales documents, debts and payments, ledger balances and the chart of accounts, with T-SQL filters. Edits ship switched off.
instructions:
## Rivile GAMA
This connector uses the **Rivile API v2** (REST web services) of Rivile GAMA, the Lithuanian ERP and accounting system: clients, products and stock, purchase and sales documents, debts, payments, the general ledger and the chart of accounts. Every call goes to one address, `POST https://api.manorivile.lt/client/v2`, with a method name such as `GET_N08_LIST` and its parameters.

**Setup**
1. Rivile API v2 needs an API access agreement with Rivile, Rivile GAMA version 119 or later and the **Manorivile-Gateway** application installed on a computer or server that reaches your GAMA database (your Rivile partner installs it). The gateway must be running for any call to work: a 502 means it is stopped or cannot reach the database.
2. Rivile issues the **API key** with the service. Paste it into `RIVILE_API_KEY`; the connector sends it in the `ApiKey` header. The part before the dot is the GAMA user the API works as, so the key sees what that user sees.

**Table codes**: Rivile names tables with a letter and two digits, and fields with the table code plus a suffix: `N08_KODAS_KS` is the client code in table N08. The suffix tells which list a code points to: `_PS` products and services, `_US` units, `_IS` divisions, `_KS` clients, `_GS` groups, `_SS` ledger accounts, `_OS` objects. The tools here: N08 clients, N17 products and services, I17 stock balances, I33 prices, I06 purchase and sales documents (lines I07), I09 internal operations, I31 debit and credit operations, I44 detailed debts, T03 debt totals, I53 payment operations, I04 receipts and payments register, I02 ledger operations, N01 chart of accounts, N07 divisions, N06 objects, N25 purchase and sales codes, N63 VAT classifiers, N45 currencies, N51 contracts, B00 import and export operations. `rivile_call_read_method` reaches every other GET_ method.

**Filters (`fil`)**: a T-SQL WHERE condition on the method's table, without the word WHERE: `n08_pav like '%ACME%'`, `i06_dok_data between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-31' and i06_kodas_ks='121411842'`. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, decimals use a dot, and codes are upper case, compared without trailing spaces. A wrong field name returns a 400 with the database's message.

**Paging**: every list returns at most 100 records. Without a filter or page you get the first page, which for documents holds the newest. Rivile recommends filtering on the key of the last record you got rather than paging deep. Rivile bills the API by the number of requests, so prefer one well filtered call over many pages, and keep to 10 requests a second (429 means wait at least a second).

**Writing**: the edit tools (clients, products, documents) are installed **switched off**. Each call changes one record; `oper` is I to create, U to update and D to delete. Turn a tool on only when the assistant should change Rivile, and confirm each change with the user. The connector has no payment, POS, gift card or payroll write tools.

**Errors**: 401 means the API key is wrong or expired; a 400 saying the key "neturi leidimo vykdyti metodą" means the key is not allowed to run that method, which Rivile enables per key in your API agreement; 502 the Manorivile-Gateway is not running or cannot reach the database; 504 the database answered too slowly (narrow the filter); 400 lists the faulty field and Rivile's message.
prerequisites: Rivile GAMA 119 or later with a Rivile API v2 agreement, the Manorivile-Gateway running next to your GAMA database, and the API key Rivile issued with the service.

RIVILE_API_KEY.label: Rivile API key
RIVILE_API_KEY.help: The API key Rivile issued for API v2, in the form USERNAME.secret. The part before the dot is the GAMA user the API works as.
RIVILE_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the key alone, user name, dot and secret, without quotes or spaces.

verifyHints.401: Rivile refused the API key: it is wrong, expired or not given. Check RIVILE_API_KEY against the key Rivile issued.
verifyHints.502: The Manorivile-Gateway did not answer: it is not running, or it cannot reach the Rivile GAMA database. Start it on the server next to the database and try again.
verifyHints.504: The Rivile GAMA database answered too slowly. Try again, or narrow the filter.
verifyHints.400: Rivile refused the request. If the message says the key "neturi leidimo vykdyti metodą", the key is not allowed to run that method: ask Rivile to enable it for your API key. Otherwise the message names the faulty field or filter.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Rivile limits the API to 10 requests a second per key. Wait a second and try again.

tools.name: rivile_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (N08 client cards: customers and suppliers alike) with code, name, company and VAT codes, address, payment terms and type (N08_RUSIS). GET_N08_LIST, 100 per page.

list.description: H: client cards only (default). A: with alternative addresses, delivery and bank details (N33).

fil.description: Filter: a T-SQL WHERE condition on table N08 without the word WHERE, e.g. n08_kodas_ks='121411842' or n08_pav like '%ACME%'. Leave out for no filter. Field names are the table code plus a suffix (see the Rivile field list for N08).

pagenumber.description: Page number; each page holds up to 100 records. Leave out for the first page (the 100 newest records). For more than a few pages, filter on the key of the last record instead.

tools.name: rivile_list_products
tools.description: List product and service cards (N17) with code, name, type (N17_TIPAS 1 product, 2 service), group, units and VAT. GET_N17_LIST, 100 per page.

list.description: H: main fields only (default). A: with the related tables.

fil.description: Filter: a T-SQL WHERE condition on table N17 without the word WHERE, e.g. n17_kodas_ps='PREKE1' or n17_pav like '%cement%'. Leave out for no filter. Field names are the table code plus a suffix (see the Rivile field list for N17).

pagenumber.description: Page number; each page holds up to 100 records. Leave out for the first page (the 100 newest records). For more than a few pages, filter on the key of the last record instead.

tools.description: List stock balances (I17): quantity, reserved quantity and value per product, unit, division (warehouse), object and series. Use group to sum per product, division, object or series. GET_I17_LIST, 100 per page.

fil.description: Filter: a T-SQL WHERE condition on table I17 without the word WHERE, e.g. i17_kodas_ps='PREKE1' and i17_kodas_is='01'. Leave out for no filter. Field names are the table code plus a suffix (see the Rivile field list for I17).

pagenumber.description: Page number; each page holds up to 100 records. Leave out for the first page (the 100 newest records). For more than a few pages, filter on the key of the last record instead.

group.description: Sum balances by these fields, comma separated: I17_KODAS_PS (product), I17_KODAS_IS (division), I17_KODAS_OS (object), I17_SERIJA (series). Products are always grouped first. Slow on large databases.

tools.name: rivile_get_account_balances

beg_date.description: Period start, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today.

end_date.description: Period end, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today.

group.description: Sum by: kodas_ss (account), kodas_zs, kodas_sm, kodas_is (division), kodas_os (object), kodas_os_c, dim01 to dim15. Leave out for no grouping.

tools.name: rivile_call_read_method
tools.description: Call any other read method of the Rivile GAMA API by name (any GET_ method, or an MGAMA_GET_ method of the HR module), for data no dedicated tool covers, e.g. GET_I06_DOCS, GET_N32_LIST (price lists), GET_PS_KAIN (prices, promotions and discounts), GET_N18_LIST (units), GET_N19_LIST (groups), GET_N15_LIST (managers), GET_N60_LIST (persons), GET_I11_LIST (stock operations), GET_I15_LIST (production), GET_I25_LIST and GET_N39_LIST (fixed assets), GET_K56_LIST (CRM), GET_A06_LIST (employees). params is passed as the method documents it. GET_USER_PROC and GET_VIEWS_LIST are not accepted.

method.description: Method name, starting with GET_ or MGAMA_GET_.

tools.name: rivile_edit_client
tools.description: Create, update or delete a client card (EDIT_N08). Without N08_KODAS_KS on create, Rivile numbers the client. Installed switched off: changes the books in Rivile GAMA, confirm with the user first. Each call changes one record.

oper.description: Operation: I create, U update, D delete.

data.description: The record, keyed by table, as the Rivile field list for N08 documents, e.g. {"N08": {"N08_KODAS_KS": "121411842", "N08_PAV": "UAB Pavyzdys", "N08_RUSIS": "3", "N08_PVM_KODAS": "LT214118411"}}.

tools.name: rivile_edit_product
tools.description: Create, update or delete a product or service card (EDIT_N17). Installed switched off: changes the books in Rivile GAMA, confirm with the user first. Each call changes one record.

oper.description: Operation: I create, U update, D delete.

data.description: The record, keyed by table, as the Rivile field list for N17 documents, e.g. {"N17": {"N17_KODAS_PS": "PREKE1", "N17_PAV": "Prekė", "N17_TIPAS": "1", "N17_KODAS_US": "VNT"}}.

tools.name: rivile_edit_document
tools.description: Update or delete the header of a purchase or sales document (EDIT_I06), or create one without lines. Installed switched off: changes the books in Rivile GAMA, confirm with the user first. Each call changes one record.

oper.description: Operation: I create, U update, D delete.

data.description: The record, keyed by table, as the Rivile field list for I06 documents, e.g. {"I06": {"I06_KODAS_PO": "010R00000050", "I06_DOK_NR": "DOK-005"}}.

tools.name: rivile_create_document
tools.description: Create a purchase or sales document with its lines in one call (EDIT_I06_FULL): header I06 with lines I07. Installed switched off: posts to the books in Rivile GAMA, confirm the client, lines and totals with the user first.

errorAction.description: For several lines: EXIT stops at the first faulty line and keeps the rest, CONTINUE skips faulty lines. Leave out to reject the whole document on any error.
